protocol.platform: native Linux; existing kind with one control plane and two workers
protocol.execution: one job, serial measurements, fresh controller and namespace per run
protocol.selection: Stop if 2/s fails; otherwise highest passing rate after all three calibrations
protocol.operational_failure: Abort and retain evidence, including failed calibration

formal.inclusion: All four runs, including cold launches and low inventory

protocol.comparison: Two AB/BA run pairs; descriptive p50, p99, CPU and allocation only
protocol.primary_comparison: Geometric mean of the two paired candidate/baseline p50 ratios
protocol.uncertainty: No bootstrap interval or significance test
protocol.counter_window: Arrival-trigger start scrape to arrivals-finished end scrape; excludes subsequent drain
protocol.latency_window: All actual claims through final Ready, including drain; exported Go durations
protocol.inventory: Sampled Ready is controller-visible state, not continuous queue availability

primary_comparison.inference: Descriptive only; no confidence interval or significance test
